rationale: C17 plausibly supplied a concrete and material drafting template. It uses the same Section 301 retaliation framework, nearly identical statutory exposition, the same modification of Subpart B of part 2 of the TSUS Appendix, and a closely parallel delegation allowing USTR to suspend, modify, or terminate the trade measure through a Federal Register determination. The child adapts that machinery from increased duties against Japan to quantitative restrictions and tariff-concession suspensions responding to the EEC. C16 has highly similar USTR delegation language, while C01 closely matches the Section 301 recitals and EEC-focused tariff retaliation, but neither matches the child's overall structure as fully as C17.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Section 301(a) of the Act ... authorizes the President to take all appropriate and feasible action to obtain the elimination of an act, policy, or practice of a foreign government or instrumentality that 1) is inconsistent with the provisions of, or otherwise denies benefits to the United States under, any trade agreement; or 2) is unjustifiable, unreasonable, or discriminatory and burdens or restricts United States commerce.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Section 301(a) of the Act ... authorizes the President to take all appropriate and feasible action to obtain the elimination of an act, policy, or practice of a foreign government or instrumentality that 1) is inconsistent with the provisions of, or otherwise denies benefits to the United States under, any trade agreement; or 2) is unjustifiable, unreasonable, or discriminatory and burdens or restricts United States commerce.
shared_material.explanation: The child and C17 reproduce the same extended statutory explanation nearly verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Section 301(b) ... authorizes the President to suspend, withdraw, or prevent the application of benefits of trade agreement concessions with respect to, and to impose duties or other import restrictions on the products of, such foreign government or instrumentality. Pursuant to Section 301(a) ... such actions can be taken on a discriminatory basis solely against the foreign government or instrumentality involved. Section 301(d)(1) ... authorizes the President to take action on his own motion.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Section 301(b) ... authorizes the President to suspend, withdraw, or prevent the application of benefits of trade agreement concessions with respect to, and to impose duties or other import restrictions on the products of, such foreign government or instrumentality. Pursuant to Section 301(a) ... such actions can be taken on a discriminatory basis solely against the foreign government or instrumentality involved. Section 301(d)(1) ... authorizes the President to take action on his own motion.
shared_material.explanation: This distinctive sequence of statutory authorities is shared essentially word for word.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Subpart B of part 2 of the Appendix to the Tariff Schedules of the United States is modified as provided in Annex I to this proclamation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Subpart B of part 2 of the Appendix to the TSUS is modified as provided in the Annex to this proclamation.
shared_material.explanation: Both implement Section 301 retaliation through the same tariff-schedule location and annex-based modification.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The USTR is hereby authorized to suspend, modify, or terminate the quantitative restrictions ... and to terminate the suspension of the tariff concessions ... upon the publication in the Federal Register of his determination that such suspension, modification, or termination is justified by actions taken by the EEC ... or is otherwise appropriate, taking into account the interests of the United States.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The United States Trade Representative (USTR) is hereby authorized to suspend, modify, or terminate the increase in United States import duties ... upon the publication in the Federal Register of his determination that such suspension, modification, or termination is justified by further actions taken by Japan ... or is otherwise appropriate, taking into account relevant domestic production and employment in the United States.
shared_material.explanation: The child closely adapts C17's distinctive delegation and Federal Register determination mechanism to different measures and a different foreign actor.
